title: How to Register for eTravel (Arrival/Departure)
description: Complete the mandatory digital travel declaration for all passengers entering or leaving the Philippines.

requirements.title: Passport Details
requirements.description: Your passport number and date of issuance.

requirements.title: Flight Details
requirements.description: Airline name and flight number for your trip.

requirements.title: Personal Photo
requirements.description: A clear, recent digital photo of your face.

requirements.title: Email Address
requirements.description: To receive your confirmation and QR code.

checklist.title: Visit Portal
checklist.description: Go to the official etravel.gov.ph website within 72 hours of your travel.

checklist.title: Enter Details
checklist.description: Fill out your personal, travel, and health declaration information accurately.

checklist.title: Upload Info
checklist.description: Provide your passport details and upload a recent digital photo.

checklist.title: Save QR Code
checklist.description: Download or screenshot the generated QR code to present at immigration.

blocks.content: **eTravel** is the unified digital platform for all passengers arriving in or departing from the Philippines. It replaces the traditional paper-based arrival and departure cards.

The eTravel QR Code is commonly used for:
*   Clearing Immigration at all Philippine international airports
*   Health declaration for the Bureau of Quarantine
*   Customs declaration (integrated in some airports)

You may need an eTravel QR Code if you are:
- **Arriving in the PH:** All passengers (Filipinos and Foreigners).
- **Departing from the PH:** Only Filipino citizens (including OFWs).
- **Crew Members:** All airline crew entering the Philippines.
The digital system streamlines the airport experience and removes the need for pens and paper forms.

blocks.title: Unified Clearance
blocks.content: One QR code covers Immigration, Health (Quarantine), and often Customs, reducing the number of checkpoints.

blocks.title: Faster Processing
blocks.content: Travelers with a "Green" QR code can use the Express Lanes at the airport.

blocks.title: Official Website
blocks.content: The primary method is via [etravel.gov.ph](https://etravel.gov.ph).

blocks.title: eGovPH App
blocks.content: You can also register within the **eGovPH** mobile app for a more integrated experience.
**Pro Tip:** The **DMW Mobile App** is now the primary portal for OEC and e-Registration. Ensure your profile is 100% complete before booking appointments.

blocks.title: Visit the Portal
blocks.content: Go to [etravel.gov.ph](https://etravel.gov.ph). Be careful of fake sites that look similar but ask for payment.

blocks.title: Choose Travel Type
blocks.content: Select "Arrival" (if entering the Philippines) or "Departure" (if a Filipino citizen leaving).

blocks.title: Enter Personal Details
blocks.content: Provide your name, nationality, passport number, and **date of issuance**. Upload your personal photo when prompted.

blocks.title: Enter Travel Details
blocks.content: Input your date of travel, flight number, airline, and the purpose of your trip (e.g., Tourism, Work, Balikbayan).

blocks.title: Health & Customs Declaration
blocks.content: Answer the brief health questionnaire regarding your recent travel history and any symptoms. If arriving, complete the customs declaration section if applicable.

blocks.title: Save the QR Code
blocks.content: Once submitted, a **QR Code** will be displayed. Take a screenshot or download the PDF. You will also receive a copy via email.

Applicants may process their eTravel registration at:
- [Official eTravel Website](https://etravel.gov.ph)
- [eGovPH App](https://e.gov.ph)

Typical processing timelines include:
*   Online Form: 5–10 Minutes

The system provides an instant QR code. There is no "status tracking" needed.
*   **Green QR Code:** Cleared for entry/exit.
*   **Red QR Code:** Proceed to the Bureau of Quarantine/Immigration desk for manual verification.

Applicants may experience:
- **Website Overload:** The site may be slow during peak travel hours.
- **Photo Upload Fail:** Ensure your photo is a JPG or PNG and under 5MB.
- **Scam Sites:** Sites that look like eTravel but ask for credit card info. **eTravel is always FREE.**

items: **Wrong Flight Number:** Ensure your flight number is correct, as the system validates this against real-time flight data.
**Registering Too Early:** If you register more than 72 hours before your flight, the QR code may not be valid.

blocks.content: Always have a screenshot of your QR code ready before you land, as airport Wi-Fi can be unreliable.

items: Register while you are still at your departure airport or at home to avoid rushing at the arrival gate.
If traveling as a family, one person can create an account and add all family members to speed up the process.
Keep your passport issuance date handy, as this is a new mandatory field for 2026.

blocks.title: Do infants need an eTravel QR code?
blocks.content: Yes, every passenger, including children and infants, must have their own individual eTravel QR code.

blocks.title: Do foreign tourists need a QR code to leave the PH?
blocks.content: No, the departure eTravel registration is currently only mandatory for Filipino citizens. Foreigners only need it for arrival.
